title: The Father's Delight
story:
A little girl stood outside a bakery, looking through the window.

She admired a beautiful cake on display.

She smiled but quietly walked away.

She thought,

“I could never have something like that.”

Just then, her father called her back.

He had seen her looking.

He walked into the bakery, bought the cake, and placed it in her hands.

The girl looked surprised.

“I didn't even ask for it,” she said.

Her father smiled warmly.

“I know.

But it made me happy to give it to you.”

The girl hugged him with joy.

In life, we sometimes think God is reluctant to bless us.

But Jesus reminds us that our Heavenly Father delights in giving good gifts.

He does not give because we deserve them.

He gives because He loves His children.

His heart is generous, and His Kingdom is His gift to us.
life_lesson: Do not live in fear. Your Heavenly Father delights in blessing His children.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me with a generous heart.

Help me to trust that You desire good for me.

Remove my fear and replace it with confidence in Your care.

Teach me to receive Your gifts with gratitude and to live as a faithful child of Your Kingdom.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you see God as a loving Father who delights in giving to His children?

What fear do you need to place into His hands today?

How can you live with greater confidence in His love?
verse: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.
